notes: Informal employment % total employment (SDG 8.3.1). Total economy, both sexes, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.ECO.
Labour income share of GDP % (SDG 10.4.1). ILO modelled estimates, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.
Mean nominal monthly earnings, total (proxy for wage level). DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX. Replaces WAG_INXM_NOC_NB (404 — retired from ILO SDMX catalog).
Working poverty rate % (<$2.15/day, SDG 1.1.1). 15+ workers, both sexes, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.AGE.

Unemployment rate for advanced-educated persons (%). ISCED advanced (tertiary+), total sex, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.EDU. Replaces UNE_2UNE_SEX_EDU_RT (404 — not in ILO SDMX catalog; EDU_AGGREGATE_ADV = ISCED 5-8 advanced).
Average hourly earnings, total (proxy for gender pay gap). All occupations, total sex. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.OCU.
Employed persons working >48h/week (thousands). Total economy, total sex, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.ECO.

Social protection coverage: % population covered by at least one benefit (SDG 1.3.1). DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.SOC. SOC_CONTIG_TOTAL = population covered by at least one social protection benefit.

Collective bargaining coverage rate (%). Share of employees covered by collective agreements. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE. Replaces SOC_EXPR_NOC_RT (social protection expenditure % GDP; 404 — retired from ILO SDMX catalog). ILR_CBCT_NOC_RT is a closely related labour-relations indicator.
Long-term unemployed (12m+), thousands. 15+ workers, total sex, duration >=12 months. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.AGE.DUR. DUR_AGGREGATE_MGE12 = 12 months or more.

Youth NEET rate % (15+, survey-based ILO modelled). Total sex, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.AGE. Replaces EES_TNEE_SEX_AGE_RT (404 — not in ILO SDMX catalog). EIP_NEET_SEX_AGE_RT is the confirmed ILO NEET dataflow.
Employment in manufacturing (thousands). ISIC C, total sex, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.ECO.

Total strikes and lockouts (count). All industries, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.ECO. Replaces ILR_STR_NOC_RT (404 — not in ILO SDMX catalog). STR_TSTR_ECO_NB is the closest available strike-count dataflow.
Labour income share as % of GDP — direct ILO dataset. Annual, NOC single-dimension. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.
Informal employment rate by sex, total (%). Survey-based (not modelled). DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.
Youth (15-24) NEET rate % — SDG 8.6.1 official indicator. ILO custodian; distinct from IL-11 (15+ aggregate). DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX. 2,493 obs / 268 countries confirmed 2026-06-27.
Workers involved in strikes and lockouts (thousands). All industries, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.ECO.
Days not worked due to strikes and lockouts (total days). All industries, annual. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.ECO.
Trade union density rate (%) — share of employees who are trade union members. Annual, NOC. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.
Low pay rate by sex, total (%) — share earning below 2/3 of median hourly earnings. Primarily OECD coverage. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.

derivation.description: Manufacturing employment share = manufacturing employment / total employment (both in thousands)

notes: Manufacturing employment share (%) = manufacturing / total employment * 100. Both series from EMP_TEMP_SEX_ECO_NB. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.ECO.

derivation.description: Year-on-year change (delta) in long-term unemployment count (thousands)

notes: Annual change in long-term unemployed (thousands). Derived from IL-10 base series via diff. DSD: REF_AREA.FREQ.MEASURE.SEX.AGE.DUR.
